> This is an independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or spo"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"nsored by Anthropic or DeepSeek. “Claude Code” identifies the version-pinned interaction target; no "},{"id":"p7s3","text":"Anthropic source code is included. See the trademark and compatibility notice."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install and run"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Version `0.1.11` uses DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` and requires Node.js **24.9+** (`>=24.9.0`). Unsupported Node"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" versions fail before changing your DSH Home."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The package includes its pinned Harness runtime; no separate global DSH installation is required."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The `legacy-peer-deps` flag avoids npm's expensive resolution of unused upstream Web UI peers. It sk"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ips peer-conflict enforcement; the package explicitly includes the required TUI services and pins it"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"s DSH dependencies. The installed-package gate checks the complete `npm ls --all` tree and rejects m"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"issing, invalid, or conflicting dependencies. Ordinary npm peer resolution was also qualified for `0"},{"id":"p12s5","text":".1.11`, though a cold installation can take several minutes. The flag does not change the DSH runtim"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"e version or TUI behavior."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"A real model request needs credentials for the DSH provider you select. Use `/provider` to inspect o"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"r enter credentials and `/model` (or `Option+P` / `Alt+P`) to switch among the models and effort lev"},{"id":"p13s3","text":" and `/model` (or `Option+P` / `Alt+P`) to switch among the models and effort levels exposed by DSH."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"For repeat use:"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"The global install exposes both `dshtui` and the canonical `dsh-claude-tui` command. Resume work wit"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"h `dshtui --resume` for the Session picker, or `--resume <session-id>` for an exact Session."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 adaptation"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Version `0.1.11` pins Harness `0.2.2-rc.1` at upstream commit `66491b05e3f05ad35bcdd4f6cd7ed26041d9e"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"3db` and requires Node.js **24.9+**. External runtimes must satisfy `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.2.3` and pass t"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"he behavioral probe. See the adaptation record and release notes."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- Native and PTC execution use DSH's explicit executor plugins. `DSH_TOOLS_MODE=native|ptc` remains "},{"id":"p19s2","text":"a TUI option, with `code` as a PTC alias; the launcher rejects `both` before discovery or Home write"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"s. Direct-profile startup uses the same validation, and executor selection trims surrounding whitesp"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"ace.
- Model selection uses `agent.model.current()` and `select()`. Selections persist immediately, "},{"id":"p19s5","text":"including choices not yet used in a request. Resume preserves them unless this invocation explicitly"},{"id":"p19s6","text":" selects another route; a prepared step and retries retain their captured model.
- Cordis, Loader, G"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"roup, and Schemastery follow the target's published versions. Session projections follow their ownin"},{"id":"p19s8","text":"g services and activation lifecycle.
- The official bilingual documentation mirror contains 2,373 or"},{"id":"p19s9","text":"iginal files from the exact release and is excluded from npm packages."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"For local use after building:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"DSH continues to store V4 Sessions. Supported predecessor migrations preserve originals. New events "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"and independent forks can be incompatible with older V4 readers; use separate Homes for cross-versio"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"n testing. The optional SQLite Session backend was removed in `0.1.2`; export those older Sessions w"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"ith their original runtime first. SQLite query/index storage is a separate service."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| Area | User-facing behavior |"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Familiar terminal | Claude-shaped welcome panel, prompt, menus, transcript, status rows, approvals"},{"id":"p26s2","text":", questions, and Agent states |
| Real Harness runtime | DSH-owned models, durable Sessions, command"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"s, approval policies, tools, structured questions, and subagents |
| Live model setup | Provider/mod"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"el catalog, advertised effort levels, saved defaults, masked API-key entry, and credential-source vi"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"sibility |
| Productive prompting | Multiline editing, image paste, submit or steer, cancellation, h"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"istory search, slash completion, and bounded `@` file mentions |
| Clear execution | Reasoning and t"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"ool activity, compact/expanded results, cache hit rate, token totals, TTFT, throughput, and turn out"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"come |
| Session and Agent flow | New or resumed Sessions, graceful flush, managed subagent activati"},{"id":"p26s9","text":"ons, completion notices, and an active-agent roster |
| Verified runtime identity | Welcome panel sh"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"ows the actual TUI/Harness version, bundled or system runtime, DSH Home, and tool mode |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The TUI reads capabilities from DSH rather than hardcoding model, effort, credential, or approval be"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"havior. Harness remains the source of truth; Claude-only cloud services, account state, model behavi"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"or, and private permission semantics are not simulated."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Compatibility and verification"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"The original interaction baseline is the observed Claude Code `2.1.227` TUI; the `[Image #1]` Ctrl+V"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" composer behavior was independently observed against `2.1.237`. The 24 original PTY frames remain u"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"nchanged. Version `0.1.10` adds 9 independent frames from the installed Claude Code `2.1.311`, with "},{"id":"p29s4","text":"4 used as automated anchors for the shell, slash menu, completed response, and structured question. "},{"id":"p29s5","text":"The original corpus retains 21 active anchors; its slash frame is now historical. See the UX validat"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ion and comparisons and DSH adaptation record for verified scope and remaining limits."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Gates exercise true-color, xterm-compatible `80x24` and `100x30` layouts, images, command attachme"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"nts, approvals, questions, plan-mode keys, managed subagents, and directory changes.
- Installed-art"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"ifact gates exercise fresh npm installation, both command names, bundled and separate-runtime probes"},{"id":"p30s4","text":", local Messages/Files and MCP servers, sandboxed Node PTC, graceful exit and resume, and V0/V3-to-V"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"4 migration with original-file preservation. These local servers do not qualify production-provider "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"behavior.
- Earlier macOS counts and Ubuntu run 38099441670 qualify the historical `0.2.0-rc.2` adap"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"tation only. This TUI's own C"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"I still runs only on Ubuntu, however, and no Windows packed-TUI/ConPTY UAT has been recorded. Window"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"s is therefore an implemented but currently unqualified target, not a supported release platform.
